note: Three trial types for the first building test. Fields are defined in docs/asset-spec.md, "Connectors". A trial type may change without a migration.

sides.a: Right edge of a facade module, seen from outside
sides.b: Left edge of a facade module, seen from outside

frame.a: At the bottom of the outer face, on the right edge. +Z points along the facade, away from the module. +Y points up.
frame.b: At the bottom of the outer face, on the left edge. +Z points along the facade, away from the module. +Y points up.

frame.a: At the top of the outer face, on the left edge seen from outside. +Z points up. +Y points out of the facade.
frame.b: At the bottom of the outer face, on the left edge seen from outside. +Z points down. +Y points out of the facade.

sides.a: The frame a door hangs in

frame.a: On the hinge line, at the bottom of the opening. +Z points across the opening, towards the leaf. +Y points up.
frame.b: On the hinge line, at the bottom of the leaf. +Z points away from the leaf. +Y points up.
